QUOTE: Mutexes only exist if you enable `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` plus an implementation. ... `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` (line 2196) and `MBEDTLS_THREADING_ALT` (line 2185) are also off. ... links `-lpthread` only when `THREADING_C` and `THREADING_PTHREAD` are both enabled.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names both MBEDTLS_THREADING_C and MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD as the macros that gate locking and the pthread link, which is what the item asks for.
